description: A Kotlin Android Activity class that serves as a quick preview entry point. It creates a hardcoded RatingInfo object and immediately launches the PostPlaybackRatingActivity with this info, then finishes itself.

classes.name: RatingPreviewEntryActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that, upon creation, sets a theme, creates a RatingInfo object with preset data, starts another activity (PostPlaybackRatingActivity) passing the RatingInfo via intent, and then finishes itself.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the activity, sets a theme, creates a dummy RatingInfo object, launches another activity passing this info, and finishes.
